## Review checklist

- [ ] Tests or documentation cover the behavior change.
- [ ] No credentials, reconnect tokens, private deployment details, or generated artifacts are included.
- [ ] README, configuration, protocol, and release notes are updated when needed.
- [ ] Security, privacy, and operational impacts are described.
- [ ] Breaking changes and migration steps are called out.
